# Load libraries
```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(here)
if (!exists("case.", inherits = FALSE)) case. <- data.table::fcase
```

# Main Annotation Pipeline
```{r annotation_pipeline}
# ============================================
# 1. LOAD INPUT FILES
# ============================================
cat("Loading input files...\n")
maf <- fread("/Users/jennyyu/Documents/llm_genomics/codes/VCF_annotate/data_mutations_extended_somatic.oncokb.txt")
cosmic <- fread("/Users/jennyyu/Documents/llm_genomics/codes/VCF_annotate/CancerMutationCensus_AllData_v102_GRCh37.tsv")
alphamissense <- fread("/Users/jennyyu/Documents/llm_genomics/codes/VCF_annotate/AlphaMissense_hg19.tsv")

cat("Original MAF rows:", nrow(maf), "\n")

# ============================================
# CHECK/CREATE MUTATION_ID
# ============================================
cat("\nChecking for mutation_id column...\n")

if (!"mutation_id" %in% names(maf)) {
  cat("mutation_id column not found. Creating mutation_id using row indices...\n")
  maf[, mutation_id := .I]  # .I gives the row number in data.table
  cat("Created mutation_id column with values from 1 to", nrow(maf), "\n")
} else {
  cat("mutation_id column already exists.\n")
  
  # Check for any issues with existing mutation_id
  n_unique <- length(unique(maf$mutation_id))
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(maf$mutation_id))
  n_duplicates <- sum(duplicated(maf$mutation_id))
  
  cat("  - Total rows:", nrow(maf), "\n")
  cat("  - Unique mutation_ids:", n_unique, "\n")
  cat("  - Missing mutation_ids:", n_missing, "\n")
  cat("  - Duplicate mutation_ids:", n_duplicates, "\n")
  
  # Warn if there are issues
  if (n_missing > 0) {
    warning("There are ", n_missing, " missing mutation_ids in the MAF file!")
  }
  if (n_duplicates > 0) {
    warning("There are ", n_duplicates, " duplicate mutation_ids in the original MAF file!")
  }
}

# ============================================
# 2. PROCESS COSMIC/CLINVAR ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================
cat("\nProcessing COSMIC/ClinVar annotations...\n")

# Clean column names in cosmic
cosmic <- setnames(cosmic, colnames(cosmic), gsub(" ", "_", colnames(cosmic)))

# Check for duplicates in cosmic
cosmic_duplicates <- cosmic[, .N, by = .(GENE_NAME, Mutation_AA)][N > 1]
cat("Duplicate GENE_NAME/Mutation_AA combinations in COSMIC:", nrow(cosmic_duplicates), "\n")

# Remove duplicates from cosmic (keep first occurrence)
cosmic_unique <- unique(cosmic, by = c("GENE_NAME", "Mutation_AA"))
cat("Unique COSMIC entries:", nrow(cosmic_unique), "\n")

# Merge MAF with COSMIC/ClinVar
maf_cosmic <- merge(
  maf, 
  cosmic_unique[, .(GENE_NAME, Mutation_AA, CLINVAR_CLNSIG, CLINVAR_TRAIT)], 
  by.x = c("Hugo_Symbol", "HGVSp_Short"), 
  by.y = c("GENE_NAME", "Mutation_AA"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Create ClinVar labels with consistent naming
maf_cosmic[, ClinVar_label := case.(
  grepl("pathogenic", CLINVAR_CLNSIG, ignore.case = TRUE), "Oncogenic",
  grepl("benign", CLINVAR_CLNSIG, ignore.case = TRUE), "Benign",
  default = "VUS"
)]

cat("MAF rows after COSMIC merge:", nrow(maf_cosmic), "\n")
cat("ClinVar annotation distribution:\n")
print(table(maf_cosmic$ClinVar_label, useNA = "ifany"))

# ============================================
# 3. PROCESS ALPHAMISSENSE ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================
cat("\nProcessing AlphaMissense annotations...\n")

# Add chromosome prefix for merging
maf_cosmic[, CHROM := paste0("chr", Chromosome)]

# Merge with AlphaMissense
maf_annotated <- merge(
  maf_cosmic,
  alphamissense,
  by.x = c("CHROM", "Start_Position", "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"),
  by.y = c("#CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Check for duplicates caused by multiple transcripts
duplicates_before <- sum(duplicated(maf_annotated$mutation_id))
cat("Duplicate mutation_ids before deduplication:", duplicates_before, "\n")

# If there are duplicates, keep the one with highest pathogenicity score
if (duplicates_before > 0) {
  # Add transcript count before deduplication
  maf_annotated[, n_transcripts := .N, by = mutation_id]
  
  # Keep row with highest am_pathogenicity score per mutation_id
  maf_annotated <- maf_annotated[order(mutation_id, -am_pathogenicity)][
    , .SD[1], by = mutation_id
  ]
  
  cat("Duplicate mutation_ids after deduplication:", sum(duplicated(maf_annotated$mutation_id)), "\n")
}

# Create AlphaMissense labels with consistent naming
maf_annotated[, AlphaMissense_label := case.(
  am_class == "pathogenic", "Oncogenic",
  am_class == "benign", "Benign",
  default = "VUS"
)]

cat("AlphaMissense annotation distribution:\n")
print(table(maf_annotated$AlphaMissense_label, useNA = "ifany"))

# ============================================
# 4. CLEAN UP AND SELECT FINAL COLUMNS
# ============================================
# Remove temporary columns
maf_annotated[, CHROM := NULL]

# Select and order columns for final output
# Keep original MAF columns plus new annotations
original_cols <- names(maf)
new_annotation_cols <- c("ClinVar_label", "CLINVAR_CLNSIG", "CLINVAR_TRAIT",
                        "AlphaMissense_label", "am_class", "am_pathogenicity",
                        "n_transcripts")

# Only include columns that exist
existing_new_cols <- intersect(new_annotation_cols, names(maf_annotated))
final_cols <- c(original_cols, existing_new_cols)
maf_final <- maf_annotated[, ..final_cols]

# ============================================
# 6. VALIDATE FINAL MUTATION_ID
# ============================================
cat("\nValidating final mutation_id integrity...\n")
final_duplicates <- sum(duplicated(maf_final$mutation_id))
if (final_duplicates > 0) {
  warning("Final output still has ", final_duplicates, " duplicate mutation_ids!")
} else {
  cat("✓ All mutation_ids are unique in final output\n")
}

# ============================================
# 5. SAVE OUTPUT
# ============================================
output_path <- "/Users/jennyyu/Documents/llm_genomics/codes/VCF_annotate/maf_annotated_final.csv"
cat("\nSaving annotated MAF to:", output_path, "\n")
write.csv(maf_final, output_path, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnnotation complete!\n")
cat("Final output rows:", nrow(maf_final), "\n")
cat("Final output columns:", ncol(maf_final), "\n")

# ============================================
# 6. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================
cat("\n=== ANNOTATION SUMMARY ===\n")

# Cross-tabulation of annotations
cat("\nClinVar vs AlphaMissense cross-tabulation:\n")
print(table(ClinVar = maf_final$ClinVar_label, 
           AlphaMissense = maf_final$AlphaMissense_label,
           useNA = "ifany"))

# Agreement statistics
maf_final[, agreement := ClinVar_label == AlphaMissense_label]
agreement_rate <- mean(maf_final$agreement, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
cat("\nAgreement rate between ClinVar and AlphaMissense:", 
    sprintf("%.2f%%", agreement_rate), "\n")

# Show sample of final data
cat("\nSample of final annotated data:\n")
print(maf_final[1:min(5, nrow(maf_final)), 
                .(mutation_id, Hugo_Symbol, HGVSp_Short, 
                  ClinVar_label, AlphaMissense_label)])
```
